property__first_hand_disclaimer.value: The image comprises a photograph taken on 6 August 2026 at the airspace near the Development (i.e. at approximately 102 metres (in height) above the Hong Kong Principal Datum) and a rendering of Unit A1, 29/F, Tower 1 of the Development. It is not intended to show the actual condition of the unit. The image has been edited and processed with computerized imaging techniques, is not drawn to scale and represents an artist’s impression only. The buildings, facilities and environment, etc. surrounding the Development may be simplified, embellished, not be drawn to scale or not be shown. The Development is still under construction. The image only shows the general appearance of the Development after completion and does not illustrate or represent the final appearance of the Development or the view from the Development or any part thereof upon completion, and is for reference only. The view of the residential properties in the Development is affected by its orientation, floor, surrounding buildings, facilities and environment, etc. The layout, partitions, specifications, measurements, colours, materials, fittings, finishes, appliances, furniture, decorative items, plants, landscape, store and other objects, etc. shown in the image may not appear in the Development or any part thereof or its vicinity when the Development is completed in the future. Details of the fittings, finishes and appliances of the residential property are set out in the Sales Brochure. The provision of fittings, finishes and appliances (if any) is subject to the terms and conditions of the Agreement for Sale and Purchase. The use of the roof/balcony/utility platform of the residential property is subject to the Deed of Mutual Covenant and the relevant laws. The Vendor does not make, and shall not be construed as making, any contractual term, offer, representation, undertaking or warranty, whether express or implied, regarding whether any item could be placed on the roof/balcony/utility platform of the residential property or the use of the roof/balcony/utility platform of the residential property.
